tasks.title: Instagram 科技创作者筛选（加拿大或美国）
tasks.detail: 已合格 1/2，已核验 1；证据不足者保持待核实。

request.personaText: 寻找 2 位 Instagram 科技内容创作者，创作者所在地为 Canada 或 United States，粉丝数 10,000 至 100,000（含边界）。分享科技内容为必选文字条件；没有视觉条件，无邮箱要求。最多搜索并核验 4 位候选。仅检索与核验，不进行任何外联。

evidence.text: Fresh profile: About.country is United States; follower_count is 79,634; bio says “I’m The Geek” and “Daily #tech and #pc tips.”
The contact tool reported the public website https://imthegeek.com/ from profile text.

creators.displayName: Tech tips | Tech support | IT Consultant

lanes.shortfallReason: Only one candidate passed all account-level hard conditions among the four candidates searched and verified; the requested total of four was not met, and the candidate cap was exhausted. The qualification tool reported that this legacy run has no structured qualification bundle, so hard conditions were assessed manually from the retained profile evidence.
